task: Four friends (Liam, Maya, Noah, Zoe) each own a car of a different color (red, blue, green, black). Constraints: Liam does not have the green car. Maya's car is neither red nor black. Noah's car is blue. Zoe's car is not blue. Liam's car is not red. Who has the red car?

Five employees (A, B, C, D, E) each work on a different weekday (Monday to Friday). Constraints: A works earlier in the week than C. B works on Wednesday. D works the day after E. C does not work on Friday. Which employee works on Monday?

Four siblings (Olivia, Peter, Quinn, Rachel) each have a different hobby (painting, knitting, chess, gardening). Constraints: Olivia's hobby is not gardening. Peter does not do painting or chess. Quinn's hobby is chess. Rachel's hobby is not knitting. Peter's hobby is not gardening. Who's hobby is painting?

Five numbered boxes (1-5) each contain a different colored ball (red, blue, yellow, green, white). Constraints: The red ball is in a lower-numbered box than the green ball. The blue ball is not in box 1 or 5. The yellow ball is in box 3. The white ball is in a higher-numbered box than the blue ball. The green ball is not in box 4. Which box contains the green ball?

Four chefs (Al, Ben, Cara, Dan) each specialize in a different cuisine (Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Thai). Constraints: Al does not cook Thai or Mexican. Ben's cuisine is not Italian. Cara's cuisine is Japanese. Dan's cuisine is not Thai. Who cooks Italian?

Five runners (Fiona, George, Hannah, Ian, Julia) finished a race in distinct positions 1-5. Constraints: Fiona finished ahead of George. Hannah did not finish last. Ian finished exactly two places behind Julia. George finished ahead of Julia. Which runner finished in 3rd place?

Four detectives (Mia, Nate, Owen, Priya) each solved a different case (theft, arson, fraud, kidnapping). Constraints: Mia solved the fraud case. Nate did not solve the arson case. Owen solved the case that comes immediately before the fraud case alphabetically. Priya solved the kidnapping case. Which case did Owen solve?

Five paintings (A, B, C, D, E) are hung on a wall from left to right. Constraints: Painting B is left of painting D. Painting C is immediately right of painting A. Painting E is not at either end. Painting D is not adjacent to painting E. Painting B is not at the leftmost position. Which painting is in the middle position?

Four musicians (Lara, Mike, Nina, Omar) each play a different instrument (violin, piano, saxophone, trumpet). Constraints: Lara does not play the trumpet. Mike does not play the piano or saxophone. Nina plays the instrument that comes alphabetically first among the four. Omar plays the instrument that comes alphabetically last. Who plays the piano?

Five conference rooms (R1-R5) are assigned to five meetings (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Epsilon) each on a different day (Monday to Friday). Constraints: Alpha is on Monday. Beta is not on Wednesday. Gamma is scheduled the day after Delta. Epsilon is on Friday. Delta is not on Tuesday. Which meeting is on Wednesday?

Four friends Alex, Maya, Raj, and Zoe each have a different hobby: painting, chess, gardening, or pottery. Constraints: Alex does not garden. Maya's hobby is not chess. Raj likes chess. Zoe does not paint. The painter is not Alex. The potter is not Maya. Who gardens?

Five coworkers Liam, Nina, Omar, Priya, and Quinn have office numbers 101‑105. Constraints: Liam's office number is lower than Nina's. Omar's office is not 103. Priya's office number is exactly two higher than Quinn's. Nina does not have 105. The person in 101 is not Omar. Who has office 104?

Three detectives Cole, Dana, and Eli each solved a different case: robbery, arson, or fraud. Constraints: Cole did not solve the fraud case. Dana solved the robbery case. The arson case was not solved by Eli. Who solved the fraud case?

Four chefs Rita, Sam, Tia, and Victor each specialize in a cuisine: Italian, Japanese, Mexican, or Thai. Constraints: Sam does not cook Thai. Rita's cuisine is not Mexican. Victor cooks Japanese. The chef who cooks Italian is not Tia. Sam's cuisine alphabetically precedes Rita's. Who cooks Mexican?

Five runners Ava, Ben, Cara, Dan, and Eva finished 1st‑5th in a race. Constraints: Ava did not finish first or last. Ben finished ahead of Dan. Cara finished exactly two places behind Eva. The runner in position 3 is not Ben. The runner in position 5 is not Dan. Dan finished ahead of Ava. Who finished in position 2?

Three siblings Mia, Noah, and Owen each received a different colored bike: red, blue, or green. Constraints: Mia did not get the green bike. Noah's bike is not red. The blue bike is not Owen's. The sibling whose name starts with a vowel got the red bike. Who got the red bike?

Four planets Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars each have a unique number of moons (0,1,2,3). Constraints: Mercury has fewer moons than Venus. Earth does not have 2 moons. Mars has more moons than Earth. The planet with 0 moons is not Mercury. Venus does not have the most moons. Who has 3 moons?

Five books Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Epsilon are placed on a shelf left to right. Constraints: Alpha is not at either end. Beta is not in the first position. Gamma is immediately to the right of Beta. Delta is somewhere to the left of Epsilon. Alpha is somewhere to the right of Delta. Beta is not adjacent to Epsilon. Delta is not adjacent to Gamma. Which book is in the third position from the left?

Four employees Lara, Mike, Nina, and Omar each took a different day off (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). Constraints: Lara did not take Monday. Mike took a day before Nina. Omar took Thursday. Nina did not take Wednesday. The person who took Tuesday is not Lara. Who took Monday?

Three islands X, Y, and Z each have a unique fruit tree: apple, banana, or cherry. Constraints: Island X does not have cherry. Island Y's tree is not banana. The island with the apple tree is north of the island with the banana tree. Island Z is south of Island X. Who has the cherry tree?

Four coworkers each have a different favorite fruit (apple, banana, cherry, date). Their names are Alex, Blake, Casey, and Dana. Constraints: Alex does not like banana or date. Blake likes cherry. Dana does not like apple. Casey does not like date. Who likes banana?

Five books are placed on a shelf, each by a different author (A, B, C, D, E) and each of a different genre (mystery, romance, sci‑fi, history, poetry). Constraints: The mystery book is not by author A and is immediately left of the romance book. The sci‑fi book is by author C and is the rightmost book. The poetry book is immediately right of the history book. Author B's book is immediately left of the poetry book. The poetry book is by author E. The mystery book is immediately left of the romance book. Who wrote the mystery book?

Five employees (Liam, Maya, Noah, Owen, Priya) sit in a row of chairs numbered 1 (leftmost) to 5 (rightmost). Constraints: Liam sits in chair 2. Maya sits immediately to the right of Liam. Noah does not sit in chair 5. Owen sits in an odd‑numbered chair. Priya sits next to Noah. Who sits in chair 4?

Four houses stand in a line, each a different color (red, blue, green, yellow) and owned by a different family (Kim, Lee, Patel, Singh). Constraints: The red house is left of the blue house. The green house is not at an end. The Patel family lives in the yellow house. The Kim family does not live in the red house. The Lee family lives immediately right of the green house. The Singh family lives in the red house. Who lives in the red house?

Three distinct digits A, B, C are chosen from 0‑9. Constraints: The three‑digit number ABC is divisible by 3. The three‑digit number BCA is divisible by 4. The three‑digit number CAB is divisible by 5. What is the digit B?

Four teams (Raptors, Sharks, Tigers, Vultures) finish 1st to 4th with no ties. Constraints: The Sharks did not finish immediately after the Raptors. The Tigers finished ahead of the Vultures. The team in 2nd place beat the team in 4th place. The Raptors finished third. The Sharks finished ahead of the Tigers. Who finished first?

Five talks (W, X, Y, Z, V) are scheduled in slots 1‑5. Constraints: Talk X is scheduled after talk W but before talk Y. Talk Z is scheduled immediately before talk V. Talk W is not in slot 1. Talk Y is not in slot 2. Who is scheduled in slot 3?

Six books (A, B, C, D, E, F) are arranged on a shelf left to right. Constraints: Book C is somewhere to the left of Book D. Book A is immediately to the left of Book B. Book E is immediately to the right of Book C. Book F is somewhere to the right of Book B but left of Book D. Book A is not the leftmost book. Which book is immediately to the right of the leftmost book?

Four chores (Laundry, Dishes, Vacuuming, Gardening) are done Monday through Thursday. Constraints: Laundry is not done on Monday. Gardening is done immediately after Vacuuming. Dishes are done before Laundry. Vacuuming is not done on Thursday. The chore done on Monday is not Dishes. Which chore is done on Tuesday?

Five secret agents (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Echo) each receive a unique code number from 1 to 5. Constraints: Alpha's code is not 1. Bravo's code is exactly two higher than Delta's code. Charlie's code is an odd number. Echo's code is not adjacent to Alpha's code. The sum of Alpha's and Bravo's codes is 7. Delta's code is an even number. Charlie's code is higher than Echo's code. Who has code 3?

Four coworkers—Alice, Bob, Carol, and Dave—each drive a different colored car (red, blue, green, yellow). Alice doesn’t drive red or blue. Bob drives the green car. Carol’s car is not yellow. Dave’s car is not red. Who drives the blue car?

Five books—Math, History, Science, Art, and Music—are placed on a shelf in positions 1 to 5 from left to right. The Science book is immediately to the left of the Art book. The Music book is somewhere to the right of the History book. The Math book is at one of the ends. The Art book is not at the far right. The History book is not at an end. The Science book is not at an end. Who is in position 3?

Four suspects—Liam, Noah, Owen, and Paul—each wore a different colored hat (black, white, gray, brown). Liam did not wear black or brown. Noah’s hat is lighter than Owen’s (white < gray < brown < black). The gray hat is not worn by Paul. The white hat is either Liam’s or Noah’s. Noah’s hat is not gray. Who wore the gray hat?

Three chefs—Rita, Sam, and Tom—each prepared a different cuisine (Italian, Japanese, Mexican). The chef who made Mexican cuisine finished before the chef who made Italian cuisine. Rita did not prepare Japanese. Sam’s cuisine is not Mexican. The Japanese cuisine was prepared after the Italian cuisine. Tom did not prepare Mexican cuisine. Rita finished before Sam. Tom finished immediately after Rita. Who prepared the Italian cuisine?

Four runners—Anna, Ben, Cara, and Dan—each ran a different distance (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km). The 10 km runner finished ahead of Anna. Dan ran the longest distance. Cara did not run 5 km. The 15 km runner finished behind Ben. The 5 km runner finished ahead of the 20 km runner. Cara finished ahead of Ben. Who ran the 10 km distance?

Five paintings—A, B, C, D, and E—are hung from left to right in a gallery. Painting C is not at an end. Painting A is immediately to the right of painting B. Painting D is somewhere to the left of painting E. Painting B is not adjacent to painting D. Painting E is the third painting from the left. Who is the leftmost painting?

Four colleagues—Mia, Noah, Owen, and Pia—each took a different mode of transport to work (car, bike, bus, train). Noah took the car. Mia did not take the bus. Owen’s transport is faster than Mia’s. The train is slower than the bike. The bike is not taken by Pia. Owen did not take the bike. Who took the train?

Three architects—Lara, Milo, and Nina—designed three buildings (office, library, museum) in three cities (Paris, Rome, Tokyo). The museum is not in Rome. Lara’s building is not the library. The building in Tokyo is an office. Milo’s building is in Paris. The library is not in Paris. Who designed the museum?

Four scientists—Dr. A, Dr. B, Dr. C, and Dr. D—each published a paper in a different year (2018, 2019, 2020, 2021). Dr. C published in 2020. Dr. A did not publish in 2021. Dr. B’s paper was published after Dr. A’s and was not in 2019. Dr. D’s paper was not the earliest. Who published in 2018?

Five chefs—Chef1, Chef2, Chef3, Chef4, and Chef5—are assigned to the five courses of a meal (appetizer, soup, salad, main, dessert). Chef3 does not prepare the soup. The appetizer is prepared by the chef who also prepares the dessert. Chef2 prepares the salad. Chef5 prepares the main course. Chef4 prepares a course that comes before the soup in the meal order. Who prepares the soup?

Four coworkers Maya, Leo, Nina, Omar each drive a different car: sedan, SUV, coupe, hatchback. Maya does not drive the SUV. Leo drives the coupe. The sedan is driven by the person whose name starts with a vowel. Omar does not drive the hatchback. Who drives the sedan?

Five books A, B, C, D, E are placed on a shelf left to right. A is not at an end. B is immediately to the right of D. C is somewhere left of A. E is at the far right. The book that is immediately left of E is the one that is not adjacent to C. Who is directly left of E?

Four chefs Raj, Sara, Tom, Uma each cook a different cuisine: Italian, Mexican, Thai, Japanese. Raj does not cook Mexican or Japanese. Sara cooks the cuisine that comes alphabetically before Tom's cuisine. The chef who cooks Thai is not adjacent (in alphabetical order of names) to the chef who cooks Japanese. Uma cooks Japanese. Who cooks Italian?

Five runners Alex, Ben, Cara, Dan, Eva finish in distinct positions 1‑5. Alex does not finish next to Ben. Cara finishes ahead of Dan. Dan finishes exactly two places behind Eva. Ben finishes in an odd position and not in 3rd place, and Ben finishes before Alex. Who finishes in 3rd place?

Five paintings Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple are hung in a row left to right (positions 1‑5). Red is not at an end. Blue is immediately to the right of Green. Yellow is somewhere to the left of Red. Purple is not in position 3. Yellow is directly left of Red. The painting in the first position is not Green. Which painting is in the middle position (position 3)?

Three scientists Dr. Lee, Dr. Patel, Dr. Kim each work in a different field: physics, chemistry, biology. Dr. Lee does not work in chemistry. Dr. Patel works in the field that comes alphabetically after Dr. Kim's field. The scientist in biology does not have a name starting with K. Who works in physics?

Four musicians Alex, Brooke, Chris, Dana each play a different instrument: violin, trumpet, saxophone, cello. Alex does not play the trumpet. The saxophone is played immediately to the right of the violin. Brooke sits two seats away from the cello. Chris sits next to Alex. Dana does not sit at the far right end. Who plays the trumpet?

Five chefs Hannah, Ian, Julia, Karl, Leah each prepare a distinct dish: stew, pie, soup, salad, grill. Hannah's dish is alphabetically before Ian's dish. Julia does not prepare salad. The dish that comes alphabetically after Karl's dish is stew. Leah prepares grill. The first position on the list is not green. Who prepares pie?

Four hikers Maya, Noah, Owen, Paige each start at a different corner: North, East, South, West. Maya does not start at East. Noah starts at the corner clockwise from Maya's. Owen starts at the corner opposite Paige's. No one starts at the North corner. Who starts at the West corner?

Five runners Liam, Maya, Noah, Owen, Paige finish in distinct places 1‑5. Liam does not finish 1st. Maya finishes immediately after Liam. Noah finishes two places ahead of Owen. Paige does not finish 5th. The runner in 3rd place is not Noah. Who finishes 4th?

Six colleagues Adam, Bella, Carl, Dina, Ethan, Fiona each work on a different project: Alpha, Beta, Delta, Epsilon, Gamma, Zeta. Adam does not work on Gamma or Zeta. Bella works on the project that comes alphabetically after Carl's project. Ethan works on Delta. The project that comes alphabetically after Fiona's project is Beta. The project Alpha is not assigned to anyone whose name starts with a vowel. Who works on the project Gamma?

Four friends (Mia, Noah, Owen, Priya) each have a different colored car (red, blue, green, yellow). Constraints: 1) Mia's car is not red or yellow. 2) The blue car belongs to the person whose name starts with a consonant. 3) Owen's car is green. 4) Noah does not own the blue car. 5) Priya's car is not yellow. Who owns the red car?

Four events (Meeting, Workshop, Seminar, Conference) occur on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, one per day. Constraints: 1) The Seminar is not on Monday. 2) The Workshop occurs the day after the Meeting. 3) The Conference is scheduled before the Seminar. 4) The Meeting is not on Thursday. 5) The Seminar is scheduled immediately after the Conference. 6) The Conference is not on Wednesday. On which day does the Conference occur?

Five siblings (Alex, Ben, Cara, Dan, Eva) each have a different hobby (painting, knitting, chess, gardening, cycling). Constraints: 1) Alex does not do cycling or gardening. 2) Ben's hobby is not chess. 3) Cara's hobby is not painting nor knitting. 4) Dan does gardening. 5) The person who does cycling is not Eva. 6) Alex's hobby is knitting. 7) The only person who does cycling is Ben. Who does chess?

Four books (Novel, Poetry, Biography, Science) are placed on a shelf from left (position 1) to right (position 4). Constraints: 1) The Poetry book is not at an end. 2) The Science book is immediately to the right of the Novel. 3) The Biography is somewhere to the left of the Poetry. 4) The Novel is not in position 2. Which book is in position 3?

Five employees (Grace, Hugo, Ivy, Jack, Kate) each work on a different project (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Epsilon). Constraints: 1) Grace does not work on Alpha or Epsilon. 2) The Beta project is assigned to the person whose name starts with a vowel. 3) Ivy works on Beta. 4) Jack's project comes alphabetically after Hugo's project. 5) Kate's project is not Delta. 6) Hugo does not work on Alpha. Who works on the Alpha project?

Four chefs (Lara, Mike, Nina, Omar) each specialize in a different cuisine (Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Thai) and sit in seats 1 to 4 from left to right. Constraints: 1) Lara does not specialize in Mexican or Thai. 2) The chef who specializes in Japanese is seated to the left of the chef who specializes in Thai. 3) Mike's cuisine is alphabetically after Nina's cuisine. 4) Omar does not specialize in Italian. 5) The Mexican cuisine is immediately to the right of the Japanese cuisine. 6) Omar sits in seat 4. Which cuisine does Mike specialize in?

Five cities (A, B, C, D, E) lie west to east in that order. Each city hosts a different festival (Music, Food, Art, Film, Dance). Constraints: 1) The Music festival is not in the easternmost city. 2) City C hosts the Film festival. 3) The Food festival is two cities east of the Music festival. 4) The Art festival is somewhere west of the Dance festival. 5) City A is the westernmost city. Which festival is held in City D?

Three detectives (Cole, Dana, Eli) each solved a different case (Robbery, Arson, Fraud) on different days (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday). Constraints: 1) The detective who solved the Fraud case did it on Tuesday. 2) Cole did not solve the Robbery case. 3) Dana solved the case on Monday. 4) The Arson case was not solved on Wednesday. Who solved the Robbery case?

Four runners (Fiona, Greg, Hannah, Ian) finished a race in distinct positions 1st to 4th. Constraints: 1) Fiona did not finish last. 2) Greg finished ahead of Hannah. 3) The runner who finished 2nd is not Ian. 4) Hannah finished exactly one place behind the runner who finished 3rd. 5) Fiona finished ahead of Greg. 6) The runner who finished 1st is not Ian. Who finished 1st?

Five books (P, Q, R, S, T) are displayed on a shelf from left to right. Each book belongs to a different genre (Mystery, Romance, SciFi, Thriller, Biography). Constraints: 1) The Mystery book is immediately to the left of the Romance book. 2) Book R is not a Thriller. 3) The SciFi book is somewhere to the right of Book Q but to the left of Book T. 4) Book P is the Biography. 5) The Thriller book is at one of the ends. 6) Book S is not a Romance. Which genre is Book S?

Four coworkers (Anna, Ben, Cara, Dan) each have a different favorite fruit (apple, banana, cherry, date). Anna doesn't like banana or date. Ben's favorite is not apple. Cara likes cherry. Dan's favorite is not banana. Who likes apple?

Five books (Mystery, Romance, SciFi, History, Poetry) are placed on a shelf numbered 1 (leftmost) to 5 (rightmost). SciFi is not at an end. Romance is immediately left of History. Mystery is somewhere to the right of Poetry. History is not adjacent to SciFi. The book in position 5 is not Mystery. Which book is in position 3?
Three runners (Liam, Maya, Noah) finish a race in distinct positions 1-3. Maya does not finish last. Liam finishes ahead of Noah. The runner in position 2 is not Liam. Who finishes first?

Four siblings (Olivia, Peter, Quinn, Rosa) each received a different grade (A, B, C, D) on a test. Olivia did not get a C. Peter got a higher grade than Quinn. Rosa received a lower grade than Olivia. The student with grade B is not Peter. Who received grade A?

Five employees (Tom, Uma, Victor, Wendy, Xander) sit in a row of five chairs numbered 1 (leftmost) to 5 (rightmost). Tom is not at an end. Uma sits immediately to the right of Tom. Victor sits two seats away from Wendy (exactly one seat between them). Xander sits at seat 5. No two employees share a seat. Who sits in seat 3?

Four cars (sedan, coupe, convertible, SUV) are parked in spots A, B, C, D (left to right). The sedan is not in spot A. The SUV is parked immediately to the left of the coupe. The convertible is parked somewhere to the right of the sedan. The car in spot D is not the SUV. Which car is in spot B?

Three chefs (Aisha, Bruno, Carla) each specialize in a different cuisine (Italian, Japanese, Mexican). Aisha does not cook Mexican. Bruno's cuisine is alphabetically before Carla's. The chef who cooks Italian is not Aisha. Who cooks Japanese?

Four planets (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) are labeled with numbers 1 (closest to the sun) to 4 (farthest). Mercury is not labeled 1. Venus's label is exactly one less than Earth's label. Mars's label is the highest number. Which planet is labeled 2?

Four detectives (Mia, Noah, Owen, Paige) each solved a different case (robbery, arson, fraud, kidnapping). Mia did not solve the fraud case. Noah solved the case that comes alphabetically before Owen's case. Paige solved the kidnapping case. The arson case was not solved by Owen. Mia's case comes alphabetically after Noah's case. Who solved the robbery case?

Four colors (orange, purple, red, teal) are assigned to four flags (A, B, C, D) with constraints: Flag A is not orange. Flag D is the color that comes alphabetically after Flag B's color. Flag C's color is not adjacent alphabetically to Flag A's color (in the order orange, purple, red, teal). Flag B is not teal. Which flag is purple?

Four siblings Anna, Ben, Cara, and Dan each have a different favorite sport: tennis, baseball, swimming, and basketball. Constraints: Anna does not like baseball or basketball. Ben's favorite is not swimming. Cara's sport comes alphabetically after Ben's sport. Dan's sport is the only one that starts with an 'S'. Who's favorite sport is tennis?

Four books titled Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow are placed on a shelf from left to right. Constraints: The Red book is not at an end. The Blue book is immediately to the right of the Green book. The Yellow book is somewhere to the left of the Red book. The Green book is not adjacent to the Yellow book. Which book is at the far right?

Four chefs Alex, Brooke, Carlos, and Dana each specialize in a different cuisine: French, Greek, Indian, Korean. Constraints: Alex does not specialize in Greek or Indian. Dana's cuisine is the only one that starts with a 'K'. The French cuisine is alphabetically before the Greek cuisine. Brooke's cuisine is alphabetically after Alex's cuisine. Who specializes in French cuisine?

Four trains W, X, Y, Z arrive at a station one after another. Constraints: Train X arrives before Train Y. Train Z does not arrive first or last. Train W arrives immediately after Train Z. Train Y arrives after Train W. Which train arrives third?

Six friends Alex, Beth, Carl, Dana, Eli, and Fiona sit around a circular table, each drinking a different beverage: coffee, tea, juice, water, soda, milk. Constraints: Alex does not drink soda nor milk. Beth sits directly opposite Carl. The person drinking tea sits immediately to Beth's right. Dana drinks the only hot beverage. The coffee is not adjacent to the juice. Who drinks soda?

Four artists Ivy, Jack, Kara, and Leo each paint a canvas using a distinct primary color: red, blue, yellow, green. Constraints: Ivy does not use red or green. Jack's canvas is the color that comes alphabetically after Kara's color. Leo uses the only color that starts with a 'G'. The blue canvas is not used by the artist whose name starts with a vowel. Who uses yellow?

Five meetings A, B, C, D, E are scheduled Monday through Friday, one per day. Constraints: Meeting A is not on Monday or Friday. Meeting B is scheduled the day after Meeting C. Meeting D is scheduled two days before Meeting E. Meeting C is not scheduled on Wednesday. Which meeting takes place on Thursday?

Four books W, X, Y, Z are placed on a shelf from left to right. Constraints: Book W is not at either end. Book X is immediately to the right of Book Y. Book Z is somewhere to the left of Book W. Book Y is not adjacent to Book Z. Which book is at the far right?

Seven musicians A, B, C, D, E, F, G sit in a row for a photo, each playing a different instrument: piano, violin, cello, trumpet, flute, drums, saxophone. Constraints: A sits to the left of B. C sits immediately right of the person playing the trumpet. The violinist sits at one end. D does not play drums. The saxophone player sits directly between the flute player and the cello player, in that order. D sits at the far left. A does not sit next to the saxophone player. Who plays the trumpet?

Four chefs Ethan, Liam, Maya, and Noah are assigned distinct dishes: ramen, sushi, tacos, udon. Constraints: Liam does not prepare ramen nor sushi. Maya's dish comes alphabetically before Noah's dish. Ethan prepares the only dish that starts with 'S' (sushi). Noah's dish is not tacos. The udon is prepared by the chef whose name starts with a consonant. Who prepares the ramen?

Four coworkers—Anna, Ben, Carla, and Dan—each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, cherry, or date. The constraints are: 1) Anna's favorite is neither banana nor date. 2) Carla's favorite is not cherry. 3) Dan's favorite is not apple. 4) Ben's favorite fruit comes alphabetically immediately after Carla's favorite. 5) Ben does not like banana. Which coworker's favorite fruit is cherry?

Five books titled "Quantum", "Renaissance", "Mystery", "Adventure", and "History" are placed on a shelf in positions 1 through 5 from left to right. The constraints are: 1) "Quantum" is not at either end. 2) "Renaissance" is immediately to the left of "Mystery". 3) "Adventure" is somewhere to the right of "History". 4) "History" is not adjacent to "Quantum". 5) "Mystery" is not at the rightmost position. Which book occupies the middle position?

Three chefs—Liam, Maya, and Omar—each cook a different cuisine: Italian, Japanese, or Mexican. The constraints are: 1) Liam does not cook Mexican. 2) Maya's cuisine is alphabetically before Omar's cuisine. 3) The chef who cooks Japanese is not Maya. 4) The Italian cuisine is not cooked by Omar. Which chef cooks Japanese?

Four runners—Eve, Frank, Grace, and Hugo—finished a race in distinct positions 1 through 4. The constraints are: 1) Eve did not finish last. 2) Frank finished exactly two places ahead of Grace. 3) Hugo finished before Eve. 4) The runner who finished second is not Grace. Who finished first?

Four friends—Nina, Owen, Paul, and Quinn—each have a different hobby: painting, knitting, sailing, or hiking. The constraints are: 1) Nina's hobby is not hiking. 2) Owen's hobby alphabetically follows Nina's hobby. 3) Paul does not have painting. 4) Quinn's hobby is not the one that comes first alphabetically. 5) Owen does not have sailing. Which friend's hobby is sailing?

Five planets—Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, and Jupiter—each receive a distinct orbital‑period rank from 1 (shortest) to 5 (longest). The constraints are: 1) Mercury's rank is not 5. 2) Venus's rank is exactly one more than Earth's rank. 3) Mars's rank is lower than Jupiter's rank. 4) The planet with rank 2 is not Earth. 5) Jupiter's rank is not 3. Which planet has rank 4?

Four detectives—Avery, Blake, Casey, and Drew—each solved a different type of case: theft, arson, fraud, or homicide. The constraints are: 1) Avery solved the theft case. 2) The arson case was solved by the detective whose name comes alphabetically after the one who solved the fraud case. 3) Blake did not solve the homicide. 4) Casey's case is not arson. Who solved the homicide?

Five books—P, Q, R, S, and T—are placed on a shelf in positions 1 through 5 from left to right. The constraints are: 1) Book Q is not at an end. 2) Book R is immediately to the right of Book P. 3) Book S is somewhere to the left of Book T. 4) Book T is not adjacent to Book Q. 5) Book P is not in position 3. Which book is in position 4?

Four employees—Anna, Ben, Cara, and Dan—each work a different shift: morning, afternoon, night, or swing. The constraints are: 1) Anna does not work the night shift. 2) The swing shift is worked by the person whose name comes alphabetically after the person who works the afternoon shift. 3) Ben's shift is not morning. 4) Dan works the night shift. 5) Anna does not work the morning shift. Who works the swing shift?

Five houses numbered 1 through 5 from left to right are painted orange, purple, red, teal, and yellow. The constraints are: 1) House 1 is not orange. 2) The purple house is immediately to the left of the red house. 3) The teal house is somewhere to the right of the yellow house. 4) The orange house is not at an end. 5) House 5 is not teal. 6) House 3 is not teal. Which house is orange?

Four coworkers (Anna, Ben, Cara, Dan) each have a different favorite fruit (apple, banana, cherry, date). Anna does not like banana or date. Ben's favorite is not apple. Cara likes cherry. Dan does not like banana. Who likes apple?

Five books (red, blue, green, yellow, purple) are placed on a shelf in positions 1‑5. The green book is immediately to the left of the red book. The blue book is not at an end. The purple book is somewhere to the right of the yellow book. The red book is not adjacent to the blue book. Additionally, the yellow book is not at an end. Which book is in position 3?

Three chefs (Liam, Maya, Omar) each specialize in a different cuisine (Italian, Japanese, Mexican). Liam does not cook Mexican. Maya does not cook Italian. Omar does not cook Japanese. The chef who cooks Japanese is seated to the left of the chef who cooks Italian. Maya sits at the rightmost seat. Who cooks Mexican?

Four musicians (Eli, Fiona, Greg, Hana) each play a distinct instrument (violin, cello, flute, trumpet). Hana plays the violin. Eli does not play the trumpet. Greg does not play the cello. The instrument that comes alphabetically second (flute) is played by the musician whose name comes alphabetically third. Fiona's instrument is alphabetically after Eli's instrument. Who plays the cello?

Five runners (Ava, Ben, Cara, Dan, Eva) finish a race in distinct positions 1‑5. Ava finishes ahead of Ben. Dan finishes immediately after Cara. Eva does not finish last. Ben finishes in position 3. The runner who finishes first is not Ava. Who finishes fourth?

Four meetings (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta) are scheduled on Monday‑Thursday. Alpha is not on Monday. Beta is scheduled the day after Gamma. Delta is scheduled earlier in the week than Alpha. Gamma is not on Thursday. The meeting on Tuesday is not Beta. On which day is Delta held?

Four treasure chests (A, B, C, D) each contain a different gem (ruby, sapphire, emerald, topaz). Chest A does not contain the ruby. The emerald is in the chest immediately to the left of the chest with the sapphire. Chest D contains the topaz. The ruby is not in chest C. The chest with the sapphire is not at an end. Chest A is to the left of chest D and chest C is immediately to the right of chest A. Which chest contains the emerald?

Four train cars (1,2,3,4) each carry a different cargo (coal, grain, oil, timber). Car 1 does not carry timber. The car carrying oil is immediately after the car carrying grain. Timber is not in car 4. Car 2 carries timber. Which car carries oil?

Six friends (Olivia, Paul, Quinn, Rita, Sam, Tina) sit around a circular table. Olivia sits directly opposite Paul. Quinn sits immediately to the right of Rita. Sam does not sit next to Quinn. Rita sits two seats away from Olivia. Paul sits immediately to the left of Sam. Who sits directly opposite Quinn?

Four library sections (History, Math, Poetry, Science) each have a different number of books (12, 18, 24, 30). The Poetry section does not have 12 books. The Science section has twice as many books as the History section. The Math section has fewer books than the Poetry section. The section with 24 books is not History. The History section does not have the most books. How many books are in the Math section?

Four friends—Alex, Blake, Casey, and Drew—each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, cherry, or date. Alex does not like banana nor date. Blake's favorite is not apple. Casey likes cherry. Drew's favorite fruit comes alphabetically after Alex's favorite. Who likes apple?

Four runners—Maya, Noah, Owen, and Priya—finished a race in positions 1st through 4th. Maya did not finish last. Noah finished ahead of Priya. Owen finished exactly two places after Maya. The runner in 2nd place is not Priya. The runner who finished 1st is not Noah. Who finished 3rd?

Four houses in a row are painted red, blue, green, or yellow, each owned by a different person: Ethan, Fiona, Greg, or Hannah. Ethan lives in the red house. The blue house is immediately to the left of Hannah's house. Greg does not live in the green house. Fiona's house is not at an end. Hannah's house is not yellow. The blue house is not owned by Fiona. Who lives in the yellow house?

Four lockers numbered 1 to 4 each contain a different item: book, pen, key, or map. Locker 1 does not contain the map. The pen is in a locker with a higher number than the book. The key is not in locker 4. The map is in the locker immediately after the locker with the pen. The key is in a lower-numbered locker than the book. Who has the key?

Four colleagues—Ian, Jenna, Kyle, and Leah—schedule one meeting each on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday. Ian's meeting is not on Thursday. Jenna's meeting is the day after Kyle's. Leah's meeting is on Monday or Wednesday. The meeting on Tuesday is not Ian's. The goat is not in cage 1. Who meets on Thursday?

Six animals—fox, goat, horse, iguana, llama, mouse—are placed in cages numbered 1 to 6. The fox is not in cage 1 or 6. The goat is in a lower-numbered cage than the horse. The iguana is in the cage whose number equals the sum of the cage numbers of the fox and the mouse. The llama is in the highest-numbered cage that is not occupied by the fox. The goat's cage number is even. The iguana is not in cage 3. Who is in cage 3?

Four friends—Olivia, Paul, Quinn, and Rita—each wear a different colored shirt: orange, purple, red, or teal. Olivia does not wear red nor teal. Paul wears the shirt that is alphabetically before Quinn's shirt color. Rita's shirt is not orange. The purple shirt is worn by the person whose name comes later alphabetically than the person in the orange shirt. Quinn does not wear red. Who wears the teal shirt?

Four researchers—Sam, Tara, Umar, and Vera—each give a 30‑minute presentation in one of four consecutive time slots: 9:00, 9:30, 10:00, or 10:30. Sam does not present at 9:30. Umar presents immediately after the researcher who presents at 9:00. Tara's presentation is not the last slot. Vera presents at 10:30 or earlier, but not at 9:00. The researcher at 9:30 presents before Vera. Sam presents earlier than Vera. Tara does not present at 9:00. Who presents at 10:00?

Four friends—Olivia, Paul, Quinn, and Rita—each wear a different colored shirt: orange, purple, red, or teal. Olivia does not wear red nor teal. Paul wears the shirt that is alphabetically before Quinn's shirt color. Rita's shirt is not orange. The purple shirt is worn by the person whose name comes later alphabetically than the person in the orange shirt. Quinn does not wear red. Who wears the teal shirt?

Four books—History, Math, Poetry, and Science—are placed on a shelf from left to right. The History book is not at either end. The Math book is somewhere to the left of the Poetry book. The Science book is adjacent to the History book. The Poetry book is not immediately next to the Math book. Who is the leftmost book?

Four friends—Victor, Wendy, Xavier, and Yara—sit around a circular table, each drinking a distinct beverage: water, juice, lemonade, or tea. Victor sits directly opposite Wendy. Xavier sits to the immediate right of the person drinking water. Yara's drink is not tea. The person drinking lemonade sits opposite Victor. Who drinks juice?

Four friends (Liam, Maya, Noah, Zoe) each own a different car model (Sedan, Coupe, SUV, Hatchback). Constraints: 1) Liam does not own the SUV. 2) Maya's car is not the Coupe. 3) The car that comes alphabetically first among the remaining models after Zoe's car is removed is owned by Noah. 4) Zoe's car is the Sedan. Which car does Maya own?

Five books (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple) are placed on a shelf in positions 1‑5 from left to right. Constraints: 1) The Red book is not at an end. 2) The Blue book is immediately to the right of the Green book. 3) The Yellow book is somewhere to the left of the Purple book. 4) The Green book is not adjacent to the Purple book. 5) The Red book is exactly two positions away from the Yellow book. Which book occupies position 3?

Four runners (Ava, Ben, Cara, Dan) finish a race in distinct positions 1‑4. Constraints: 1) Ava does not finish in the middle (positions 2 or 3). 2) Ben finishes ahead of Cara. 3) Dan finishes exactly one place after the runner who finishes first. 4) The runner in position 3 finishes ahead of Ava. Who finishes in position 2?

Five employees (Grace, Henry, Iris, Jack, Kelly) each work a different shift (Morning, Midday, Evening, Night, Swing). Constraints: 1) Grace does not work the Night shift. 2) Henry's shift is earlier in the day than Jack's shift. 3) Iris works the shift that is exactly two positions later than the Morning shift in the order Morning < Midday < Evening < Night < Swing. 4) Kelly works the Swing shift. 5) The Midday shift is not assigned to Henry. Which shift does Grace work?

Four owners (Emma, Finn, Gina, Hugo) each have a different pet (cat, dog, rabbit, hamster). Constraints: 1) Emma does not own the rabbit or hamster. 2) Finn's pet's name comes alphabetically after Gina's pet's name. 3) Hugo owns the hamster. 4) The pet that is alphabetically first among the remaining after removing dog is not owned by Gina. Which pet does Finn own?

Five musicians (Ari, Ben, Cara, Dex, Eve) each play a distinct instrument (cello, flute, piano, trumpet, violin). Constraints: 1) Ari does not play the piano or trumpet. 2) Ben plays the instrument that is two positions after Cara's instrument in the alphabetical list: cello, flute, piano, trumpet, violin. 3) Eve plays the instrument that comes alphabetically before Dex's instrument. 4) The trumpet is not played by Dex. 5) The flute is played by the musician whose name comes first alphabetically among those who do not play violin. Which instrument does Dex play?

Four cities (Oslo, Paris, Quito, Rome) are visited in order 1‑4 on a tour. Constraints: 1) Oslo is not visited immediately before or after Paris. 2) Quito is visited two places after Rome. 3) Paris is visited before Quito. 4) The first city visited is not Rome. 5) Oslo is visited before Rome. Which city is visited third?

Four programmers (Ada, Ben, Cara, Dan) each work on a different project (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta). Constraints: 1) Ada does not work on Beta or Delta. 2) Ben works on the project that is alphabetically after Cara's project. 3) Dan works on the project that comes first alphabetically among the remaining after removing Alpha. 4) The project Gamma is not assigned to Ben. Which project does Cara work on?

Five books (A, B, C, D, E) are placed on a shelf in positions 1‑5 left to right. Constraints: 1) Book A is not adjacent to Book D. 2) Book B is somewhere to the left of Book C. 3) Book E is exactly in the middle position. 4) Book D is two positions to the right of Book B. 5) Book C is not at an end. Which book is in position 4?

Four athletes (Kyle, Luis, Maya, Nina) each run a different distance (100m, 200m, 400m, 800m). Constraints: 1) Kyle does not run 400m or 800m. 2) Luis runs the distance that is exactly double the distance Maya runs. 3) Nina runs a longer distance than Kyle. 4) The 200m distance is not run by Maya. Which distance does Luis run?
